jobs.title: Drift Wood #38 · signing off
jobs.prompt: a four-panel comic strip laid out as a two-by-two grid on a half page, thin black panel borders (4 panels). Style: black and white comic strip panel, scratchy crow-quill pen and ballpoint ink on cardstock, harsh photocopy contrast, heavy black spotting, jagged uneven line weights, 1990s indie comix zine style, xerox grain, no color, no gray tones. Cast, the same faces, hair and builds in every panel, ages exactly as given: WOOD — aged 19, gaunt boy drawn a head too tall, chin up, unkempt dark hair falling forward, sharp jaw; CHLOE — aged 19, girl with a sharp intelligent face, smudged heavy black eyeliner, straight dark hair to the shoulders; GULLY — aged 20, stocky boy with a round face, easy slouch. Clothes, hair-dos and anything held come from this strip's description, never from the reference sheet; hands are empty unless a panel names what they hold. Title of the strip: DRIFT WOOD. The strip: The last issue Wood edits. The strip signs off the back page. It says nothing about leaving. Panel 1: an emptied school newsroom with boxes and an unplugged computer, a stack of newspapers by the door, three teenagers sitting on the desks (in this panel: WOOD, CHLOE, GULLY). Panel 2: close-up of a teenage girl reading the back page of a school newspaper, her face reading, the page turned away from the viewer (in this panel: CHLOE). Panel 3: a teenage girl lowering a newspaper to look at a boy in an overcoat who shrugs, emptied newsroom (in this panel: CHLOE, WOOD). Panel 4: three teenagers leaving a dark emptied newsroom through its doorway, a stack of newspapers by the door, black and white (in this panel: WOOD, CHLOE, GULLY). No text, no lettering, no speech balloons, no signature; leave clean space in each panel where balloons would go. Reference @chloe_17 is the model sheet for CHLOE: match that face, hair and build exactly; do NOT copy its clothes, pose or props — those come from the strip text above. Reference @gully_17 is the model sheet for GULLY: match that face, hair and build exactly; do NOT copy its clothes, pose or props — those come from the strip text above. Reference @wood_20 is the model sheet for WOOD: match that face, hair and build exactly; do NOT copy its clothes, pose or props — those come from the strip text above. Match the attached references: @chloe_17 for the character the strip's Chloe at 17; @gully_17 for the character the strip's Gully at 17; @wood_20 for the character Wood at 20-23.
